assets.name: keeper
assets.prompt:
Side-view 2D pixel art for a game, true pixel art on a strict grid, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, limited palette of about 32 colours built on two ramps: warm amber/gold for anything lit and cold indigo/blue-black for shadow. Muted, desaturated folklore mood, quiet melancholy, not cute. Flat solid #FF00FF magenta background (or transparent), no text, no watermark, centred, generous padding.

Use case: stylized-concept
Sprite sheet, exactly 8 frames in one horizontal row: first 6 frames a complete walking-right cycle of a small hooded figure in a long indigo cloak holding a lit brass lantern out in front; frame 7 idle; frame 8 raising the lantern high in a flare. Each frame designed on a 16×24 logical pixel cell, same character scale and consistent ground baseline. Enlarge the logical pixels uniformly for presentation. Equal cell spacing, no grid lines, no labels. Flat #FF00FF background. Keep the whole character and lantern inside every cell.
